feeding_claim.verbatim: 100% Grass-Fed Beef means No Grain Ever

notes: Family farm run by Gilbert and Julie Ruegemer near Verona (town from the our story page meta description). Read homepage, our story, farming principles, pickup locations and store pages (WebFetch summaries, Verifier should recheck the quote). Homepage says beef is 100% grass-fed with no grain ever; pork, chicken and turkey get daily fresh pasture, no diet detail. Checkout offers home delivery in certain zip codes, pickup locations and on-farm pickup, but the locations page loads its list by script and none were readable. Half and whole beef deposits are listed as pre-order. Subscription option. Northern Kentucky and Cincinnati are the areas the homepage says it serves, not a confirmed delivery map. Separate from the Hillside Meadows Farm, Verona lead.
